base_rich.content:
Most of these do nothing:

**Windows gaming tweaks**

| Item | Claimed effect | Assessment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Disable HPET | Lower input latency | Caution: Skip — No measurable change in testing; can break timers. [lab.example](https://lab.example/tweaks) |
| Enable XMP | Memory runs at rated speed | Positive: Do it — Measured gains in CPU-bound games. [lab.example](https://lab.example/tweaks) |
